title: Yellow Umami Vietnamese Vegetables Bun Cha
description: A vegan-friendly and umami-rich Vietnamese dish featuring stir-fry vegetables and served with bun cha, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they are tender and lightly browned.
Add the grated carrots to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix together the yellow curry powder, soy sauce, and turmeric.
Pour the curry mixture over the vegetables in the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the vegetables are well coated with the curry mixture.
Stir in the chopped scallions and sesame seeds.
Serve the vegetable mixture over the cooked rice noodles and drizzle with lime juice.
